'''Bimmira Canyon''' was a narrow canyon located in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]], near the [[Metta Drop]]. A stone arch could be found near its entrance. At least one [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course included Bimmira Canyon on its route.
